The Forward Contract obligates V3 to deliver to the Dealer up to 945,998 shares of Common Stock in each of six tranches within one business day after each of the six maturity dates of the Forward Contract (April 1, 2027, April 15, 2027, April 29, 2027, May 13, 2027, May 27, 2027 and June 10, 2027), for an aggregate amount of up to 5,675,984 shares. In exchange for assuming this obligation, V3 received a cash payment of $100.0 million in connection with the entry into the Forward Contract. The reporting person pledged 5,675,984 shares of Common Stock (the "Pledged Shares") to secure its obligations under the Forward Contract.
